completed.title: Design and verify candidate-to-main promotion path without reviving legacy bootstrap workflows
completed.result: Promotion must not merge/rebase main into candidate. Candidate is 1925 commits ahead and 2 behind main; the two main-only commits are legacy bootstrap/slice-gate changes, while candidate intentionally removes pathena-bootstrap.yml, pathena-slice-gate.yml, .pathena-bootstrap and bootstrap payloads. Safe path is candidate-bound verification, explicit negative legacy guard, reviewed candidate->main PR/commit promotion, then main quality/release validation.
verification: main...candidate compare: diverged, ahead 1925, behind 2, merge-base efb472893cab52d7142b9b5d4447881e149dcbf2.
Main-only commits 42965edc... and 3e57e70e... are bootstrap/slice-gate history.
Candidate workflows contain only quality.yml and ui-snapshot.yml; legacy bootstrap workflows are absent.
quality.yml executes on main push and pull_request, not direct candidate push.
remaining_risks: A generic rebase/merge from main can reintroduce superseded bootstrap workflow behavior.
Candidate lacks a dedicated negative promotion guard until TASK-0016 lands.
Promotion/release still requires fresh exact Full-Windows evidence at the final candidate SHA.
